description: EffectiveSetResolver vectors (03-interfaces §4.3, 02-lld §5.2): inputs and the expected effective set or refusal. Node computes each; Python validates and recomputes each digest.

vectors.description: an org-visible MCP installation granted with a tool subset: only those tools, sorted, with their approved digests
every unavailable reason in the documented order, one per granted installation
tools.effects: only tools whose effect is inside the ceiling; an unclassified tool is dropped; an item left with none is not_granted
a required item without a credential refuses the run naming it
the same item not required: unavailable{credential_missing}, the rest ready
sharing: in a run of the agent, what the agent's owner put on it is visible to whoever runs it
sharing does not reach an item of someone other than the agent owner
an assistant run (no agent): the org, user and team grants merged; another user's item is not visible; a team item is visible to a member
a revoked and an expired per-user credential; an active one carries its binding reference
a skill is pinned by its bundle, its one descriptor; tools.grant narrows it like any item
